Inside our workshop

BODY REPAIR · PAINT · PDR IN PYLAIA

ABOUT US

At our workshop in Pylaia, Ioannis Kapageridis and his team of specialists look after every car you trust us with, from the first estimate to the day you collect it. Since 2010 we have been doing body repair, paintwork and PDR on cars of every make.

From a dent in a door to the damage from a collision, we first look for the right way to repair it. Wherever possible we use PDR, with no paint and no filler, so your car keeps its factory paint. When paint is needed, we match the colour so precisely that you cannot tell the old from the new.

We know that after an accident the last thing you want is to chase paperwork. That is why we help you with your insurance company and keep you informed at every step of the repair.

We tell you from the start when your car will be ready, and we often hand it back sooner. You get it back clean, inside and out.

Ioannis Kapageridis: the best repair is the one you cannot see.

WHAT WE DO

Body repair, paint and PDR under one roof

From a small dent in a car park to the damage from a collision, the whole repair is done in one place.

Collision body repair

We bring doors, wings, bonnets and bumpers back to their proper shape, so the car fits together again just as it did from the factory.

Learn more →

Car painting

We paint only what needs painting and match the colour precisely, so you cannot tell old from new.

Learn more →

PDR: dents without repainting

For dents where the paint is not broken: no filler, no paint, and the car keeps its factory finish.

Learn more →

ALSO

  • Bumpers: scratches, cracks and dents, repaired and painted to match your car.
  • Help with your insurer: after an accident we help you with the claim and keep you informed at every step.
  • Handed back clean: your car comes back washed and polished, inside and out.
